issues.summary: address-book-items.repository still builds an unguarded "up to N more" message (shows 0 or negative at/over the limit)
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: src/modules/spaces/domain/address-books/address-book-items.repository.ts:184 still interpolates `${this.maxItems - existingAddressBookItems}` with no guard, so users see the same "up to 0 more" wording this PR fixes for Safes. It is a real user-facing inconsistency, but the file is outside the PR's diff, so it is capped at low.

issues.summary: user-address-book-items.repository still builds an unguarded "up to N more" message (shows 0 or negative at/over the limit)
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: src/modules/spaces/domain/address-books/user-address-book-items.repository.ts:158 uses `${this.maxItems - existingCount}` with no guard, so it can show "up to 0 more" or a negative count. This is real but lies entirely outside the PR's changes, so it is at most low.

issues.summary: The e2e test still asserts the old "up to 0 more" address-book text
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: src/modules/spaces/routes/address-books.controller.e2e-spec.ts:522 correctly asserts what the unchanged address-book repository currently returns, so nothing is broken today. It only matters if the sibling fix is made later, which is a follow-up note rather than a defect.

issues.summary: The limit-message construction is duplicated across three repositories with no shared helper
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: The same template exists at space-safes.repository.ts:50-52, address-book-items.repository.ts:184 and user-address-book-items.repository.ts:158. This PR fixed only one copy, which shows the concrete cost: the fix was applied inconsistently.

issues.summary: No test covers the over-limit case (existing > max, where remaining is negative)
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: At space-safes.repository.ts:48-52 the negative case takes the same `remaining > 0` false branch that the new test already exercises with remaining === 0. A separate test would add little regression protection.

issues.summary: The new test inserts a user, wallet and member that the code under test does not need
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: SpaceSafesRepository.create (space-safes.repository.ts:30-66) uses only spaceId, so the setup at spec:436-455 is unnecessary. However, it copies the neighbouring tests' pattern and has no concrete cost.

issues.summary: The count check and the insert are not atomic, so concurrent requests could exceed the limit
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: space-safes.repository.ts:46-57 calls findBySpaceId and then insert without a transaction or lock, so two concurrent requests could both pass the check. This is real but predates the PR, whose change only touched the message text, and exceeding a soft Safe-count cap has low impact.
